en.text:
Vestiges collected by Harvester Spikes charge up 'Vestigial Alchemy'. 

After collecting 7 Vestiges (50% charge):
Enables a Hold [Reload] interaction that makes your next shot fired spawn a <special/>Special Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies, granting 10% of your <special/>Total Special Ammo Reserves


After collecting 17 Vestiges (100% charge):
Allows you to cycle Hold [Reload] a second time, making your next shot fired spawn a <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies on impact, granting 10% of your Total <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Reserves

Creating ammo bricks consumes the energy it cost to reach that level on the meter. Ammo-Spawning spikes cannot impale targets.
